title: “It’s not persecution — it’s just accountability wearing grown-up pants.”
paragraphs:
“It’s not persecution — it’s just accountability wearing grown-up pants.”
🤣 Sometimes we call it ‘spiritual warfare’ when it’s really just someone finally saying no.

“Do not be deceived: God is not mocked. A man reaps what he sows.”
— Galatians 6:7 (NIV)
